messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P99 latency alert for streaming responses on region-us-west-2 - SLO breach (p95=220ms, p99=3.8s) — paging oncall
alex: got the page, looking
maria: i'm in, seeing a sharp rise in streaming tail latency and a spike in proxy timeouts in the last 6m
jamal: same. customer-facing streams (SSE + websocket) showing stalled chunks. clients report long hangs then big bursts of tokens
alex: metrics: streaming p95 jumped from 180ms -> 650ms, p99 -> 3.8s. request rate steady. errors: proxy 504s and 'upstream timed out'
maria: stack traces show repeated 'write EPIPE' at proxy layer for connections held >60s
jamal: here's a quick curl to reproduce in prod: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate/stream?model=gpt-xx" 
```
maria: when I run that I see long pauses (10-20s) between events then a bunch of events flush
alex: looks like buffering upstream + client backpressure. Could be proxy buffering + kcmuxing of keepalive
eng-sre: adding logs from edge proxy (filtered):
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:31Z] upstream timeout after 60s for conn id=45123
[2026-03-12T14:03:02Z] write EPIPE on client 10.2.3.4
[2026-03-12T14:05:10Z] proxy_buffering: on, buffer size 8k
```
jamal: proxy_buffering on is suspect. If the proxy buffers until full, SSE chunks are delayed until the buffer flushes
maria: agreed. also seeing client-side TCP window shrink events on pcap for a specific ISP cluster (isp-phi). Could be slow consumers + buffering = head-of-line stalls
alex: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable proxy_buffering for streaming endpoints 2) bump upstream timeout 3) enable chunked transfer passthrough 4) route heavy customers to dedicated pool
support-liaison: Tier 1 reports 3 customers complaining of 'stream hangs' and one on paid Dedicated noticing p99 bursts -> customer success notified
jamal: i'm going to test disabling buffering on a canary proxy and replay stream traffic
maria: i can prepare a config snippet for nginx layer. we'll roll to a single edge node first.
```
# nginx snippet (canary)
location /v1/generate/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_read_timeout 180s;
}
```
alex: also toggling keepalive and tcp_nodelay on the upstreams to reduce coalescing
eng-runtime: we should also check runtime KV cache eviction that might trigger large serialization pauses — but metrics show no GC spikes
eng-sre: canary patch applied to edge-2 in us-west-2 at 14:12Z
jamal: canary results: immediate improvement for replayed sessions. median chunk gap down from 6s -> 0.8s on that node
maria: pushing patch to 4 additional nodes in us-west-2, rolling with 30s pause between nodes
alex: rolling now. monitoring p95/p99 in realtime. alert if p99 > 2s
incident-bot: roll started by alex at 14:15Z — tracking: roll edge nodes (4)
maria: after roll, region us-west-2 p99 down to 1.1s, p95 210ms
support-liaison: updated impacted customers: temporary mitigation applied, engineers rolling configs, will follow up with RCA
eng-runtime: deployed fallback policy for heavy streams — route to lower-latency variant with shorter context to avoid long tails (no quality-critical customers impacted by fallback)
alex: note: we saw a small number of reconnects when we disabled buffering on older clients; we should document client requirements
maria: collecting logs for RCA: proxy config diffs, tcp dump for slow consumers, and runtime trace for any blocking ops
jamal: scheduled a quick postmortem slot tomorrow 10:00 PT with eng-runtime + eng-sre + support
oncall-next: i'm taking handoff at 15:00 PT — summary for next oncall: 
- incident id: 2026-03-12-1923456789
- root cause (working): proxy buffering + slow consumer TCP windows -> chunk coalescing -> upsteam timeouts
- mitigations applied: proxy_buffering off (canary -> zone roll), upstream timeout increased to 180s, fallback routing enabled
- impact: p99 streaming latency SLO breach for ~40m window, ~3 customers reported degraded streams, no data loss
- actions in progress: RCA collection, client compatibility doc, test harness for slow-consumer replay
alex: Thanks — i've added the checklist to the incident ticket and attached the config diff + metrics graphs
maria: log links: https://logs.redwood.example/streaming/1923456789
jamal: if next oncall needs to revert, commands: 
```
kubectl -n edge rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy-canary
# or revert configmap to previous hash
kubectl -n edge set env deployment/edge-proxy CONFIG_HASH=prev123
```
oncall-next: acknowledged. i'll watch alarms and keep support loop open with customer success
support-liaison: sending follow-up emails to affected customers with ETA for RCA
incident-bot: incident status changed to mitigated by maria at 14:47Z — monitoring continued
alex: closing timeline notes. handoff to oncall-next complete. please add any remaining artifacts to the postmortem doc
maria: adding packet captures and nginx stats to the doc now
jamal: thanks everyone. good catch on proxy buffering; we'll propose default off for streaming endpoints in next config cycle :thumbsup:
